title: The deleteTeamRecords server action deletes records for any team ID without checking who is signed in.
why_it_matters: Anyone who can load the page can call this action with another team's ID and erase that team's data.
remediation: In apps/web/app/teams/actions.ts, call const user = await requireUser() first and check user.teamId === teamId before deleteMany; return 403 otherwise.
verified_by: Called the action from a second test account in a local build; the other team's records were deleted.

title: Server action in teams/actions.ts has no authorization check.
why_it_matters: Missing authorization on a destructive write.
verified_by: Pattern match on 'use server' files without requireUser, plus a manual read.

title: The image proxy fetches any URL a visitor passes, including internal addresses.
evidence:
const target = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get('u')
const res = await fetch(target!)
why_it_matters: An attacker can make the server read internal services such as the cloud metadata endpoint.
remediation: In apps/web/app/api/img/route.ts, allow only hosts in an IMAGE_HOSTS list and reject private IP ranges after DNS resolution.
verified_by: Traced the parameter to fetch(); no allowlist anywhere in the call path.

title: The billing webhook accepts events without verifying the Stripe signature.
evidence:
app.post('/webhooks/stripe', express.json(), async (req, res) => {
  const event = req.body   // no constructEvent()
why_it_matters: Anyone can post a fake 'payment succeeded' event and unlock a paid plan.
remediation: Use stripe.webhooks.constructEvent(rawBody, sig, STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET) with express.raw() on this route in apps/api/src/billing/webhook.ts.
verified_by: Sent an unsigned test event to a local server; the plan upgraded.

title: A Stripe live key prefix appears in a committed .env.example file.
why_it_matters: If this is a real key it is exposed to everyone with repo access; if it is a placeholder it trains people to paste real keys here.
remediation: Replace the value in .env.example with an obvious placeholder and rotate the key in the Stripe dashboard if it was ever real.
verified_by: Checked git history: the value has been unchanged since the first commit.

title: Content-Security-Policy and Permissions-Policy headers are not set.
why_it_matters: Without a CSP, any script injection becomes much easier to exploit.
remediation: Add a headers() block in apps/web/next.config.ts with a CSP and Permissions-Policy.
verified_by: Read next.config.ts and the deployed response headers.

title: A comment renderer passes user text to dangerouslySetInnerHTML: would run.
why_it_matters: If comment bodies are not sanitized on the server, one user can run script in another user's browser.
remediation: Render comment.body as text, or sanitize with DOMPurify before passing it to dangerouslySetInnerHTML in apps/web/components/Comment.tsx.
verified_by: Pattern match only; did not confirm whether the API sanitizes.
